size.value: 33mm (w) x 48mm (h); head width 15-22mm; 3-5mm from crown to photo top edge; chin-to-bottom-edge height >= 7mm. Matches DB value exactly (3.3 x 4.8cm).

head_height.value: 28mm - 33mm (2.8cm - 3.3cm), measured chin to crown. Matches DB value exactly.

background.value: Pure white, no blemishes, no shadows

file_spec.value: Printed photo must be professionally developed on photo-lab paper (no retouching or compositing). Digital submission: JPG/JPEG format, file size 30KB-80KB.

clothing_restriction.value: Dark-colored, collared clothing is required, not merely recommended (source states "穿深色有领上衣" as a mandatory instruction under its clothing-requirements section, distinct from the one unrelated "建议"/suggested item elsewhere on the page about using a professional studio)

expression_restriction.value: Natural expression; eyes open, lips naturally closed; face forward with level gaze — no tilting, looking up/down, or turning sideways

glasses_policy.value: Only clear, colorless lenses allowed; glasses must not obscure eye contours; no tinted lenses or heavy frames

face_visibility.value: Both eyebrows must be visible; eyes naturally open; entire head and face included in frame

headwear_policy.value: Prohibited in general; exception only for religious, medical, or cultural reasons, and even then must not obscure the face or cast a shadow

accessories.value: Jewelry (necklaces, earrings) allowed if it does not cover the face; hearing aids permitted

clothing.en: Dark-colored clothing with a collar is required, not merely recommended.
clothing.ko: 짙은 색의 카라(옷깃) 있는 옷 착용은 권장이 아닌 필수 사항입니다.
clothing.ja: 襟付きの濃い色の服装の着用は推奨ではなく必須です。

expression.en: Natural expression, eyes open, lips naturally closed, facing forward with a level gaze — no tilting, looking up or down, or turning sideways.
expression.ko: 자연스러운 표정으로 눈을 뜨고 입술을 자연스럽게 다물며, 고개를 기울이거나 위아래로 젖히거나 옆으로 돌리지 않고 정면을 응시합니다.
expression.ja: 自然な表情で目を開け唇を自然に閉じ、頭を傾けたり上下左右に向けたりせず正面を見てください。

glasses.en: Only clear, colorless lenses are allowed; glasses must not obscure the eye contours. Tinted lenses or heavy frames are not allowed.
glasses.ko: 무색 투명 렌즈의 안경만 허용되며, 안경이 눈의 윤곽을 가려서는 안 됩니다. 색안경이나 두꺼운 테는 금지됩니다.
glasses.ja: 無色透明レンズの眼鏡のみ許可され、眼鏡が目の輪郭を隠してはいけません。色付きレンズや太いフレームは禁止です。

ears.ja: 両耳が見える必要があります。

face_visibility.en: Both eyebrows must be visible, eyes naturally open, and the entire head and face must be included in the frame.
face_visibility.ko: 양쪽 눈썹이 보여야 하고 눈은 자연스럽게 뜬 상태여야 하며, 머리와 얼굴 전체가 프레임 안에 들어와야 합니다.
face_visibility.ja: 両方の眉が見える必要があり、目は自然に開けた状態で、頭と顔全体がフレーム内に収まっている必要があります。

headwear.en: Headwear is prohibited in general, with an exception only for religious, medical, or cultural reasons — and even then it must not obscure the face or cast a shadow on it.
headwear.ko: 머리 가리개는 원칙적으로 금지되며, 종교·의료·문화적 사유가 있는 경우에만 예외로 허용됩니다. 다만 이 경우에도 얼굴을 가리거나 얼굴에 그림자를 만들어서는 안 됩니다.
headwear.ja: 頭部の覆いは原則禁止です。宗教・医療・文化的な理由がある場合のみ例外が認められますが、その場合も顔を隠したり顔に影を作ったりしてはいけません。

accessories.en: Jewelry such as necklaces and earrings is allowed as long as it does not cover the face; hearing aids are permitted.
accessories.ko: 목걸이·귀걸이 등 장신구는 얼굴을 가리지 않는 범위 내에서 허용되며, 보청기는 착용할 수 있습니다.
accessories.ja: ネックレスやピアスなどのアクセサリーは顔を隠さない範囲で許可され、補聴器の着用は認められます。

cross_verification.size_and_head_height: Head height (28-33mm) and overall size (33x48mm) independently corroborated across National Immigration Administration (nia.gov.cn), MFA Consular Service Network (cs.mfa.gov.cn), and the Chinese Consulate-General in Los Angeles (losangeles.china-consulate.gov.cn); all three agree, and all match the DB value exactly. Facial/clothing/headwear/glasses restrictions independently confirmed via a direct fetch of the Chinese Embassy in Canada's official consular notice (ca.china-embassy.gov.cn).
